lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Boots off, gloves on the rail. Same order every night. It's how you find them in the morning.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dinner, sharpen, bed. In that order. Don't let anyone talk you into cards first.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Biscuit. Sit. Good. No, that's mine. Go and find Dale.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Somebody left a mug in the sink with the teabag still in it. I'm counting mugs now.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Joan's put my name on the high-score board. I've never touched the machine. I'm not starting now.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Shirts on the line before dark, or they'll smell of smoke all week.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Cards tonight? One hand. Then I'm asleep, I mean it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Ten-minute lunch. Sandwich, water, sharpen. The next tree won't wait.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Top bunk's mine. Has been since the first night. I like being able to see the whole room.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dale. It's always Dale. Earplugs are in the drawer by the sink.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: I write the day's count in the back of my diary. That's my letter home, near enough.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Kettle's on. Don't touch the big pan. Joan's got plans for it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Tell her you're doing fine. You are. Tell her that bit twice.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: You've already eaten, Dale. I watched you.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Who let the dog on the bunk? Off. Off. Fine. Five minutes, and I'm counting.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Everyone in? I'm counting heads before I sit down.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Evening, chief. Kettle's on in the cabin if you want one. Don't tell Joan I offered.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Fine. Same as always. Why, what did Dale do?

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Shower gives you two minutes of hot water. I take one. The rest of you can fight over the other.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: What's for dinner? Don't tell me. No, tell me. No, surprise me. Tell me.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit, mate. Never touched an axe, and still the most popular worker on the island.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit's had half my sausage. To be fair, the other half was always going to Biscuit as well.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I'm doing the eggs tonight. Nobody panic.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Third on the high-score board, mate. Bronze. I'll take bronze. Bronze is a metal.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Deal me in. I've got a good feeling. Same feeling I always have, mind, and I always lose.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: I don't snore. I breathe with enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: One clean shirt left, mate. Saving it for the boat. Want to look my best for the boat.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: This bunk's built for someone half my size. My feet sleep in the hallway.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Who finished the biscuits? The food ones. Not the dog. Obviously not the dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Break. I've got a sandwich in each pocket. Don't ask how long they've been in there.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Tell Ana big Dale says hello. And tell her the food's terrible, except Joan's.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Evening, mate. You eaten? You should eat. There's enough in that pot for a small army.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: One hand's not a card game, that's a handshake.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Bathroom's occupied again. Fine. I'll wash in the kettle.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Like a log, mate. A big wet log in a very small bunk.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Arcade tonight. Loser does the washing up. I'm feeling lucky.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Biscuit, mate, that's my boot. You've already had one boot this week.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Nearly home. I can smell dinner from here. Or I'm imagining it very strongly.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: You never lose because you count, mate, and I still can't prove it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Does it matter? It's hot, it's stew, and it's mine.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Notebook time. Today's trees, today's weather. It's oddly calming.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Joan holds three places on the high-score board and I hold one. I'm working on the ratio.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Dale holds his cards closer when he's got a good hand. I've stopped telling him.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Biscuit always sits next to whoever eats slowest. It's a strategy. A good one.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Is tonight's stew a new stew, or yesterday's stew continuing?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Laundry's dry on the line. It smells of woodsmoke, but it's dry.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The bathroom tap drips about once a second. I'll replace the washer tomorrow.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Measurably, it's Dale. Though Marta counts in her sleep.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I've been watching the patterns on the second machine. I'd take that bet.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Evening, boss. The cabin kettle's getting slower every day. I think it's scale. I've been timing it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I write my mother a page a day. She'll get them all at once when the boat comes. She'll love that.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Quick break. Tea, ten minutes, and nobody ask what's in the notebook.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Seven hours, roughly. The bunk below mine creaked twice.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The kitchen shelf's labelled now. Please put the salt back where it says salt.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: It's colder by the window. I've moved my sleeping bag to the other end. Small improvement.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The end of the contract, as far as I know. I'm crossing the days off, if you want to check.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Eggs need about three minutes less than you give them. Just as a data point.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The left arcade machine has a sticky jump button. That might explain the board.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Biscuit's been walking the fence line again. Mostly for dropped crusts, as far as I can tell.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Writing to Ana again. That's a lot of messages waiting for the boat now. She'll get them all at once.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Does anyone know exactly when the boat comes? For the messages, I mean.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Biscuit's sitting on my foot. Is that okay? I don't want to move. It feels rude.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I beat my own high score. Not Joan's. Just mine. That still counts, right?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Joan's teaching me cards. I've lost every hand, but I'm getting very good at shuffling.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it okay if I put the pillow over my head? It's not personal. It's just the snoring.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Sorry, is anyone in the bathroom? I'll wait. Sorry. No rush.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I made toast for everyone. I burned two. I hid them. Sorry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it dusk already? Okay. Good. I mean, good that we're in.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: My work shirt's on the line. It still smells like the truck. I don't mind, honestly.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I'll eat them. I like crunchy eggs. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Can I just watch? I'm not good at it. I'll dry the dishes, though.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Evening, boss. I wrote to Ana about you. Good things. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay, I think. I dreamt about the truck. It was a nice dream, actually.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Ten minutes in the shade. I'm keeping my boots on. If they come off, they're not going back on.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Thank you for dinner. Sorry, I say it every night. It's just always good.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: What should I tell Ana about this place? I don't want her to worry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The bunk creaks every time I turn over. I'm trying not to turn over. It's going badly.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Biscuit's asleep by the door again. I like it when Biscuit sleeps in here.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay, but go easy. I still don't understand trumps.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Morning, {listener}. How'd you sleep? Honestly, mind, not the polite version.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Dinner's up! Stew, bread, and a bit of something green so nobody gets scurvy.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Cards, sunshine? Loser does the dishes, and I never lose.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: High-score board's been updated. I'm still on top. Some of you need to practise.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Right, who was snoring last night? Own up, or I'm sending Biscuit in to investigate.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Biscuit, love, you've had dinner. I watched you have dinner. Twice.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Laundry rota's on the fridge. If your name's next to towels, it's your turn, whoever you are.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Who used the big pan and put it back wet? I'm not angry. I'm just going to find out.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Writing my sister a letter she'll get in a month. She'll think I've gone soft. Maybe I have.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: It's a living tradition, love. Eat up.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Stew, love. It's always stew. You ask every single night.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Somebody panic. Last time your eggs bounced.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Tell her you've got a whole cabin of aunties and uncles now, sunshine. And one dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: One hand, she says. Last time it was seven, and you won five of them.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Evening, boss-love. There's a plate going spare in the cabin. Don't let Dale see you take it.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Tea break, loves. Sit down before you fall down.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Bathroom's free. Mind the step, and the spider. The spider's called Gerald. Be nice to Gerald.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Lucky, he says. I've got last night's scores written down, sunshine.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: I ran a bar for twelve years, {listener}. Same as this, really. Too many tired people, not enough chairs, and somebody always wants the last biscuit. The food kind. I don't let them near the dog.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: When it comes, love. Keep writing. She'll have a lovely big stack to read.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Nobody, love, and nobody will while I've got breath in me.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Boots off. Finally.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Short break. Water and a bit of shade.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Hello, Biscuit. No, I haven't got anything. Honest.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Lights out soon. Big day tomorrow.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Kettle's just boiled if anyone wants one.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Who's on dishes tonight? Not me. I did them yesterday.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Smells like dinner. Good.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Somebody's socks are drying on the heater again.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Has anyone beaten the top score on the arcade yet?

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Come on, cards. Everyone in. Nobody's tired, they're just pretending.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Biscuit! Come here, you. Who's fed you today? Everyone? Of course they have.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Can we go inside now? It's getting dark, and dinner's ready anyway.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Sharpening tonight so I'm straight out in the morning.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: I'll carry the water in. Saves everyone two trips.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Long day. Sleep now, think about it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: The cabin clock runs five minutes fast. Someone set it that way on purpose, I reckon.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: That top arcade score? I'd bet someone found a glitch.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Truck's parked nose out for the morning. Easier start.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Whoever's rustling that crisp packet, please be done with it.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Evening, boss. Dinner's on in the cabin.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Rain on the cabin roof. Not the worst sound to rest to.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Another letter for the boat pile. It's getting thick.
